# Little AI

> Little AI is an AI consultancy that works with enterprises and domain experts to integrate AI deeply into vertical industries (accounting, legal, geological hazard assessment, AI infrastructure). Services: consulting, system design, system integration, forward deployed engineering and AI products. Contact: contact@little-ai.io

- [Full content](https://www.little-ai.io/llms-full.txt): Both languages in one file
